title: Vanilla Rogue Tweaks
description: adds tweaks that make minecraft better to play
body:
**THIS PROJECT IS IN ALPHA STAGE**
please report any bugs on the official discord server:
discord.gg/D8Hje33vrv

This modpack is designed for players who want to keep the vanilla Minecraft feel while enjoying a smoother, faster, and more enjoyable experience. Instead of overloading the game with content-heavy mods, this pack focuses on performance improvements, subtle tweaks, and quality-of-life features that enhance gameplay without taking away from what makes Minecraft special.

With a hand-picked selection of optimization mods, you’ll notice better FPS, shorter loading times, and reduced lag, even in massive worlds with large builds. It’s lightweight, efficient, and works well on most systems, making it ideal for both solo play and multiplayer servers.

But this pack isn’t just about performance — it also introduces small but impactful tweaks that improve how you interact with the game. From cleaner interfaces to smarter mechanics, every addition is chosen to make survival, building, and exploring more enjoyable while keeping the classic Minecraft vibe intact.

What you can expect:

🚀 Improved Performance – Higher FPS, faster chunk loading, and smoother gameplay.

⚡ Lightweight & Optimized – Perfect for both low- and high-end PCs.

🛠 Quality-of-Life Features – Helpful tweaks that make daily play less tedious.

🎮 Vanilla-Friendly Feel – Keeps Minecraft looking and playing the way you remember.

🌍 Great for Multiplayer – Balanced and compatible for servers or LAN play.

Whether you’re a builder who wants lag-free megabases, an adventurer exploring endless biomes, or a casual player who just wants Minecraft to run better, this pack is built to make your game faster, cleaner, and more fun — all without losing the simplicity of vanilla.
